decisionReference.quote: 历史 native `latest` 的精确删除此前由 npm 返回 E403；用户于 2026-10-24 决定放弃这项清理，不再将它作为后续 `0.2.0` 等版本发布的前置条件，也不自动重试删除。

evidence.repairFailure: npm error code E403 / 403 Forbidden - DELETE https://registry.npmjs.org/-/package/@zeus-js%2fcompiler-native/dist-tags/latest
evidence.explanation: Authentication and package ACL succeeded (baicie2, 29 published packages with read-write access) before every DELETE was refused. The same token succeeds for dist-tag add (PUT). This is a platform-side restriction on the delete operation, not a configuration error in this repository.

scope: Limited to the exact package/version pairs below. Adding a package, changing a version, or re-observing the registry must never widen this list automatically.
risk: These 16 packages resolve an unversioned install to an old canary or to a prerelease. Consumers who need a stable or current version must pin explicitly. The state predates every 0.2.0 release and is unrelated to whether a given release published correctly.
exitStrategy: Each entry leaves the baseline when its `latest` is repaired by a mechanism that permits deletion, or when a stable version supersedes it. Because `latest` cannot be deleted with the current credential, the durable exit is a stable release whose `latest` is advanced normally. An entry whose observed value no longer matches is refused from that moment on; the baseline is never silently re-pointed.

packages.name: @zeus-js/i18n
packages.authorization: Approved by maintainer:baicie on 2026-11-27. @zeus-js/i18n was a first publication in rc.5, and npm binds `latest` to a prerelease on a first publication regardless of --tag. The tag cannot be deleted with any available credential (see evidence.repairFailure), and the package has no stable version to move `latest` onto, so no mechanism in this repository can clear it. A historical exemption is the only honest record. It authorises exactly @zeus-js/i18n@0.2.0-rc.5 and nothing else.
